messages:
jane_auditor: Hi team — auditor followup: they want evidence for three items scoped to the ISO control set we provided. Specifically: 1) examples of RBAC change approvals for user/service accounts in the past 6 months; 2) exported audit logs for the KMS key used by 'private-deploy-prod' for the last 90 days; and 3) confirmation of log retention policy and where exported logs live (S3 path or internal archive). Can someone confirm where to pull these and any redaction steps?
priya_sec: Thanks @jane_auditor — we can provide change approvals as links to PRs/tickets + signed approval messages. For RBAC please confirm if they need every change or a sampling (e.g., monthly snapshots). Also note: KMS usage logs are in CloudKMS audit logs; access is restricted. We need SRE to run the export with least-privileged creds.
sam_oncall: We can do a sampling: provide the last 3 RBAC changes for org:infra and any service principals that had role escalation. I have the ticket numbers: INFRA-3212, INFRA-2987, INFRA-2745. I can attach the approval threads.
mike_sre: For KMS audit logs: we have AuditLogs.kms in Stackdriver. I can export via the logs export sink to gs://redwood-compliance-exports/kms/private-deploy-prod/90d/. Note: logs include request metadata and key version IDs; we need to scrub requestor IPs per privacy. Also rotation policy: key rotation is yearly, code comment: "rotation_period = 365d" and rotation schedule tracked in KEY-MGMT-ops doc.
priya_sec: Good notes. Auditor will also ask for evidence of rotation being enforced (not just policy). Can we provide a recent rotation event and who approved it?
mike_sre: Yep — key version 3 rotated 2025-11-03, approved by @priya_sec in ticket KEY-ROT-112. I'll include the rotation event entry from CloudKMS audit logs and the approval ticket thread.
priya_sec: On RBAC approvals, we require an approval in the ticket + owner signoff in Slack. Sam — do your listed tickets have that signoff? If not, we need to reconstruct via invite logs and manager approval.
sam_oncall: INFRA-3212 has PR and Slack + manager signoff. INFRA-2987 was emergency, only manager note in the ticket — I'll add a follow-up note explaining our emergency rollback policy. INFRA-2745 is fine.
jane_auditor: Sampling OK. Please provide: 1) exported logs (gs link) as a read-only package; 2) RBAC change artifacts (ticket links + screenshots of approvals); 3) rotation proof (audit log snippet + KEY-ROT ticket). Prefer zipped evidence with a manifest.csv listing each file and a control mapping column (ISO control ID).
priya_sec: We'll prepare a manifest. Question: what's the canonical control mapping column header you want? Our mapping file uses "control_id" but auditors prefer "ISO-27001:2013 control".
jane_auditor: Use "ISO-27001 control" in the manifest. Also include a column "evidence_type" (log, ticket, screenshot).
mike_sre: I'll kick off the export now. Using:
```
# export sink
gcloud logging sinks create compliance-kms-sink 
  --log-filter='resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName: "Encrypt"' 
  --destination=storage.googleapis.com/redwood-compliance-exports/kms/private-deploy-prod/90d 
  --project=redwood-prod
```
Will set object ACL to requester-project-private and add an expiry lifecycle 180d.
deploy-bot: export job started: compliance-kms-sink (job id: ex-2026-0451). Status: queued.
priya_sec: Important: ensure that the exported objects have a checksum and we record the SHA256 in manifest. Also add a note about redaction steps (mask IPs, remove user display names for personal accounts).
mike_sre: Will do. Also note: some KMS logs reference key ring ids that include project name — we'll obfuscate project-id in the exported JSON as per PII policy.
priya_sec: For RBAC artifacts, we'll include ticket links and screenshots. Sam, please capture the Slack approvals as screenshots (redact any unrelated messages).
sam_oncall: On it. ETA: I can upload a draft package to gs://redwood-compliance-drafts/jane/ by EOD PST.
jane_auditor: Great. One last thing — auditor asked about retention: what is current retention for CloudKMS audit logs and for IAM admin logs? We documented it as 400 days in the central policy but want the system truth.
mike_sre: System settings: Logging retention for CloudKMS is 400 days in project redwood-prod via logs bucket policy. IAM admin logs are forwarded and kept 400 days as well. Exports to compliance bucket will have lifecycle 180 days (for auditors) then archived to cold storage if needed.
priya_sec: We'll state that in the evidence cover note. Also include control mapping: ISO-27001 A.12.4 (logging), A.9.2 (user access provisioning), and A.10.1 (cryptographic controls).
jane_auditor: Perfect. Please cc me when draft upload is ready. I'll validate manifest and send a short Q&A if anything missing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
